sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [F]In the [Gm]heart of [C7]Je sus
[F/A]There is [C7/Bb]love [Bb]for [F]you,
[F]Love most pure and [C/E]tender,
[Dm]Love most [Gm]deep and [C]true;
[F/A]Why should you be lonely,
[Dm]Why for friendship [Gm]sigh,
[Gm]When the [F/C]heart [C7/Bb]of [Am]Jesus
[Gm]Has a [C7]full [F]supply?

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [F]In the mind of [Gm]Jesus there is [C7]thought for you,
[F]Warm as summer sunshine, sweet as [C/E]morning dew;
[Dm]Why should you be fearful, why take anxious [Gm]thought,
[Gm]Since the mind of Jesus [C7]cares [F]for those He bought?

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [F]In the field of [Gm]Jesus there is [C7]work for you;
[F]Such as even angels might rejoice [C/E]to do;
[Dm]Why stand idly sighing for some lifework [Gm]grand,
[Gm]While the field of [C7]Jesus seeks [F]your reaping hand?

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [F]In the home of [Gm]Jesus there's [C7]a place for you;
[F]Glorious, bright, and joyous, calm and peaceful [C/E]too;
[Dm]Why then, like a wanderer, roam with weary [Gm]pace,
[Gm]If the home of Jesus [C7]holds [F]for you a place?
